purpose: Breadth across domains and both languages: nine adjustable models (physics, nuclear chemistry, biology, pharmacology, finance, networking, earth science, road safety, electronics), two ordered processes (immunology, networking) and one request that should be declined. Topics are phrased as a learner would ask them, not as specifications; the scorer checks the contract, the renderer kind, a unit-labelled output where one is expected, and the refusal.

cases.topic: Why does a thrown ball travel farthest when launched near 45 degrees? Build an adjustable model of the range of a projectile with launch speed and angle, and a fresh numeric case.

review: Range uses the ideal no-drag formula and says so.
Angle is in degrees in the labels or the conversion is stated.
Both languages name speed, angle and range consistently.
